dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Hello, do you need medicinal herbs?

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: My father was a herb farmer. After I survived a shipwreck, I came home to help grow herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I was unable to go to sea due to the aftereffects of that shipwreck, so I reapplied for knowledge on growing herbs from the Akasha Terminal.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I survived only because of the immediate first aid. It was natural for me to support my father when he decided to provide herbs for Bimarstan for free.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: If possible, I want to pass the examination to study medicine at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Alright. I'm here if you need me for anything. Feel free to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: My father was a herb farmer. After I survived a shipwreck, I came home to help grow herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I survived only because of the immediate first aid I was given, so it was natural for me to support my father when he decided to provide herbs to Bimarstan for free.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I won't be able to go out to sea ever again, but if I can, I'd like to go to Pardis Dhyai.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: I've heard that a lot of talks there have gone public. Who knows, a bit of herb lore there and an exam here, and you'll see me next at the Akademiya studying the medical sciences!
